CreateConfig.description_en: Modifies the general alert configuration parameters
CreateConfig.description_zh: 调用CreateConfig接口修改异常告警通用配置模块的参数

CreateDataLimit.description_en: Creates a scan authorization for a database, project, or Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
CreateDataLimit.description_zh: 调用CreateDataLimit创建对数据库、项目、存储空间（Bucket）进行扫描的授权

CreateRule.description_en: Creates a custom sensitive data detection rule by calling CreateRule
CreateRule.description_zh: 调用CreateRule创建自定义的敏感数据识别规则

CreateScanTask.description_en: Calls the CreateScanTask operation to create a custom scan task for detecting sensitive data in assets that have been successfully authorized for detection
CreateScanTask.description_zh: 调用CreateScanTask接口为识别权限授权成功的资产创建识别敏感数据的定制化扫描任务

CreateSlrRole.description_en: Call CreateSlrRole to create a service-linked role for Data Security Center (DSC). This role authorizes DSC to access your cloud resources
CreateSlrRole.description_zh: 调用CreateSlrRole创建数据安全中心DSC（Data Security Center）的服务关联角色，授权DSC访问云资源

DeleteDataLimit.description_en: Deletes authorized data assets such as databases, instances, or buckets from connection authorization
DeleteDataLimit.description_zh: 调用本接口删除连接授权的库、实例、Bucket数据资产

DeleteRule.description_en: Deletes a custom sensitive data detection rule
DeleteRule.description_zh: 调用本接口删除自定义的敏感数据识别规则

DescribeAuditLogs.description_en: Queries the list of audit alert logs
DescribeAuditLogs.description_zh: 调用本接口查询审计告警日志列表

DescribeCategoryTemplateList.description_en: Queries the list of industry templates
DescribeCategoryTemplateList.description_zh: 调用本接口查询行业模板列表

DescribeCategoryTemplateRuleList.description_en: Queries a paginated list of rules in a data classification template
DescribeCategoryTemplateRuleList.description_zh: 分页获取分类分级模板的规则列表

DescribeColumns.description_en: Queries column data in data asset tables, such as MaxCompute and ApsaraDB RDS tables, that are authorized for connection by Data Security Center
DescribeColumns.description_zh: 调用DescribeColumns接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的MaxCompute、RDS等数据资产表中列的数据

DescribeColumnsV2.description_en: Queries column data in data asset tables, such as MaxCompute and ApsaraDB RDS tables, that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center
DescribeColumnsV2.description_zh: 调用DescribeColumns接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的MaxCompute、RDS等数据资产表中列的数据

DescribeConfigs.description_en: Queries common configuration items for anomaly alerts
DescribeConfigs.description_zh: 查询异常告警通用配置模块中配置项的列表

DescribeDataAssets.description_en: Searches for data assets on the Overview page of Data Security Center (DSC)
DescribeDataAssets.description_zh: 执行敏感数据保护概览页面的数据资产搜索

DescribeDataLimitDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of an authorized data asset, such as a MaxCompute project, ApsaraDB RDS database, or OSS bucket
DescribeDataLimitDetail.description_zh: 查询连接授权的单个实例、库、Bucket的详情

DescribeDataLimitSet.description_en: Call the DescribeDataLimitSet operation to query the authorization list for unstructured assets or the list of regions supported by Data Security Center
DescribeDataLimitSet.description_zh: 调用DescribeDataLimitSet接口查询非结构化资产授权列表或数据安全中心支持的地域列表

DescribeDataLimits.description_en: Queries the list of data assets, including authorized instances, databases, and buckets
DescribeDataLimits.description_zh: 调用本接口查询连接授权的实例、库、Bucket数据资产列表

DescribeDataMaskingRunHistory.description_en: Queries the execution history of data masking tasks
DescribeDataMaskingRunHistory.description_zh: 调用DescribeDataMaskingRunHistory查询脱敏任务执行情况

DescribeDataMaskingTasks.description_en: Queries the list of static data masking tasks
DescribeDataMaskingTasks.description_zh: 调用DescribeDataMaskingTasks获取脱敏任务列表

DescribeDataObjectColumnDetail.description_en: Queries the column detection results of a data table
DescribeDataObjectColumnDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据表的列识别结果

DescribeDataObjectColumnDetailV2.description_en: Queries the column detection results of a data table
DescribeDataObjectColumnDetailV2.description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据表的列识别结果

DescribeDataObjects.description_en: Queries the data detection results of data tables and files
DescribeDataObjects.description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据表、文件的数据识别结果

DescribeDocTypes.description_en: Queries the list of OSS file types that can be detected
DescribeDocTypes.description_zh: 调用本接口查询支持识别的OSS文件类型列表

DescribeEventDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a single anomalous activity, including the time when the anomalous activity occurred, the anomaly description, and the handling status
DescribeEventDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口查询单个异常事件详情，包括异常事件发生时间、异常描述及处理状态等

DescribeEventTypes.description_zh: 调用本接口查询异常事件类型的列表

DescribeEvents.description_zh: 调用本接口查询异常事件列表

DescribeIdentifyTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the completion status of a detection task by task ID. You can obtain the task ID from the ID field in the response of the CreateScanTask or ScanOssObjectV1 operation
DescribeIdentifyTaskStatus.description_zh:
根据识别任务ID获取任务的完成状态。
识别任务ID可通过调用CreateScanTask或ScanOssObjectV1，从返回值中的ID字段来获取

DescribeInstanceSources.description_en: Queries a list of data assets

DescribeInstances.description_en: Retrieves the list of data asset instances for authorized MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, and OSS connections
DescribeInstances.description_zh: 获取连接授权的MaxCompute、RDS、OSS数据资产实例列表

DescribeOssObjectDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a single OSS storage object that is authorized for connection in Data Security Center
DescribeOssObjectDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的OSS的单个存储对象的详细信息

DescribeOssObjectDetailV2.description_en: Queries the details of a single storage object in OSS that is authorized for connection to Data Security Center
DescribeOssObjectDetailV2.description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的OSS的单个存储对象的详细信息

DescribeOssObjects.description_zh: 调用本接口查询连接授权的OSS的存储对象列表

DescribePackages.description_en: Retrieves information about MaxCompute packages authorized for scanning, including package names, owner accounts, and risk levels
DescribePackages.description_zh: 调用本接口查询已完成扫描授权的MaxCompute数据包的信息，例如数据包的名称、数据包所属者的账号、数据包的风险等级等

DescribeParentInstance.description_en: Queries the list of authorized or unauthorized assets
DescribeParentInstance.description_zh: 调用本接口查询未授权或已授权资产列表

DescribeRiskLevels.description_en: Call the DescribeRiskLevels operation to retrieve a list of risk levels for sensitive data
DescribeRiskLevels.description_zh: 调用DescribeRiskLevels接口获取数据识别的风险等级列表

DescribeRules.description_en: Queries a list of sensitive data detection rules
DescribeRules.description_zh: 调用本接口查询敏感数据识别规则的列表

DescribeTables.description_en: Queries tables in data assets, such as MaxCompute and RDS, that Data Security Center is authorized to access
DescribeTables.description_zh: 查询数据安全中心连接授权的MaxCompute、RDS等数据资产的表数据

DescribeTemplateAllRules.description_en: Lists all rules in an industry-specific template
DescribeTemplateAllRules.description_zh: 调用本接口查询行业模板所有模型列表

DescribeUserStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a user account by calling DescribeUserStatus
DescribeUserStatus.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserStatus查询用户账号状态

DisableUserConfig.description_en: Calls the DisableUserConfig operation to disable a user configuration. After the user configuration is disabled, you can call the CreateConfig operation with the same request parameter Code to restore the anomaly alert general configuration for the configuration item
DisableUserConfig.description_zh: 调用DisableUserConfig接口停用用户配置。停用用户配置后，可以通过调用CreateConfig接口输入相同的请求参数Code，恢复该配置项编码的异常告警通用配置

ExecDatamask.description_en: You can call the ExecDatamask operation to dynamically mask data
ExecDatamask.description_zh: 调用ExecDatamask接口对数据进行动态脱敏

ManualTriggerMaskingProcess.description_zh: 调用ManualTriggerMaskingProcess触发一次脱敏任务

MaskOssImage.description_en: Use the MaskOssImage operation to mask images stored as objects
MaskOssImage.description_zh: 调用MaskOssImage接口来对存储对象中的图片进行脱敏

ModifyDataLimit.description_en: Modifies the configuration items of a Data Security Center (DSC) connection authorization
ModifyDataLimit.description_zh: 调用ModifyDataLimit修改DSC连接授权的配置项

ModifyDefaultLevel.description_en: Modifies the risk level definition rules for sensitive data, including the default risk level for unrecognized data and the risk level for data classified as "sensitive"
ModifyDefaultLevel.description_zh: 调用本接口修改敏感数据的风险等级定义规则，包括未能识别数据的默认风险等级、归类为“敏感”的数据风险等级

ModifyEventStatus.description_zh: 调用本接口处理异常事件

ModifyEventTypeStatus.description_en: Invokes this operation to enable the feature for detecting anomalous activity events of specified child classes
ModifyEventTypeStatus.description_zh: 调用本接口开启检测子类型异常事件的功能

ModifyReportTaskStatus.description_en: You can call the ModifyReportTaskStatus operation to enable or disable report tasks
ModifyReportTaskStatus.description_zh: 调用ModifyReportTaskStatus开启或关闭报表任务

ModifyRule.description_en: Modifies a custom sensitive data detection rule in Data Security Center (DSC)
ModifyRule.description_zh: 调用ModifyRule接口修改数据安全中心DSC（Data Security Center）中自定义的敏感数据识别规则

ModifyRuleStatus.description_en: Enables or disables the detection feature of a sensitive data detection rule
ModifyRuleStatus.description_zh: 调用本接口开启或关闭敏感数据识别规则的检测功能

RestoreOssImage.description_en: Restores an image that has been masked by calling the RestoreOssImage operation
RestoreOssImage.description_zh: 调用RestoreOssImage接口来对脱敏后的图片进行复原

ScanOssObjectV1.description_en: The ScanOssObjectV1 operation creates a scan task to detect sensitive data in a specified object
ScanOssObjectV1.description_zh: 调用ScanOssObjectV1接口为对应存储对象创建敏感数据识别的扫描任务

StopMaskingProcess.description_en: You can call the StopMaskingProcess operation to stop a data masking task. You can call the ManualTriggerMaskingProcess operation to restart a stopped task using its unique resource ID
StopMaskingProcess.description_zh: 调用StopMaskingProcess接口终止脱敏任务。终止的脱敏任务，根据唯一资源ID，可通过ManualTriggerMaskingProcess重新开启脱敏任务
